rawTicketCriteria: When both a minimum and a maximum are configured, both are shown.
Thresholds are displayed with a “<“ or “>” to say whether they apply below or above the value

The label format is “[Item type] [minimum] [condition] | [unit]”, for example:
- Express parcel = “Express 2 kg Weight < 5 kg | box”
- Ground parcel = “Ground Weight > 5 kg | pallet”
- Letter = “Letter Weight < 0.1 kg | envelope”
Note: the map placement is already correct (ie. a parcel shows up at its depot, which is the expected behavior)
